config.concurrency: shared RwLock; parallel readers, exclusive writers
config.measurement: independent homogeneous operator trials; completed calls per wall second; validation timed

workload: Scrambled Zipf theta=0.99; independent get, put, scan, sort trials on one shared database with 8 client threads; median of three fresh 30-second trials per operator; held-out seed 223
trust_boundary: The original Database trait, empty constructor and exercise are fully verified. The shared std::sync::RwLock adapter, threads, timers and runtime result validation are trusted harness code. Rust requires VerifiedDb: Send + Sync. Reads share a guard; writes use an exclusive guard. No formal concurrency/linearizability or persistence claim. Source and toolchain remain pinned.
